markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (90%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged reliability (44%, 98th-pct OOD) and model disagreement warrant recuts/levels on this frozen section.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 90%, InSitu 8%, Normal 2%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Favors benign; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha=0.10, 90% coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged), 98th-pct OOD [F6] | Unreliable input; atypical vs training |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes differ) | Foundation models split on top |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (100%, 0.75–0.89) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.085, -0.471) against invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (0.214, -0.206) against invasive [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (0.993, -0.204; caption mismatch) favors benign [F4] · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 0, 4, 11) · context · 59% neoplastic (92nd-pct) [F7]; 100th-pct shape variation [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score beyond random (0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20 spot-check), lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Flagged quality (44% reliability, 98th-pct OOD) masks InSitu (8%) or invasion while CONCH and MUSK disagree.
- High neoplastic counts in regions 4 (47) and 0 (25) with 100th-pct shape variation reflect neoplasia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4**: Inspect 25 and 47 neoplastic nuclei (3% benign epithelium [F10], 0% immune [F9]) and risk.
2. **Regions 5, 9, 2, 3**: Check duct-confined atypia (region 5), pleomorphism (region 9), and tubules (regions 2, 3).
3. **Regions 10, 11**: Check inferior (52%) and lateral (48%) margins; defer call [F11] and order recuts/levels.
